Office Worker.speaker: Office Worker
Office Worker.text: I don't even know why anymore.

Office Worker.speaker: You
Office Worker.text: [Part of his body fades into darkness.]

Student.speaker: Student
Student.text: Everyone says I have to be perfect.

Womanizer.speaker: Womanizer
Womanizer.text: Another date, another smile, another lie.

Womanizer.speaker: You
Womanizer.text: [No matter how many people surround him, the emptiness inside never seems to disappear.]

Child.speaker: Child
Child.text: Mom and Dad are always busy...

Beggar.speaker: Beggar
Beggar.text: People walk past me as if I don't exist

Beggar.speaker: Beggar
Beggar.text: Once, i had dreams and a place to belong. Now, each day is a struggle for survival

Business Woman.speaker: Business Woman
Business Woman.text: Success was supposed to make me happy

Business Woman.speaker: You
Business Woman.text: [Yet behind her confident smile lies exhaustion and a growing sense of emptiness]
